name: PageGrid
summary: A page's composition grid (DesignUp, owner 2026-11-12 23:54): the page is rows; a row splits into cells from a fixed list of splits; a cell holds more rows or is a slot for one block or fundamental. Every split divides the same twelve columns, so a nested split only subdivides its parent's span and every cell lines up with the page's columns. Rows sit a chosen stack step apart (`gap`); columns a fixed gutter apart. A row whose narrowest cell would be under `size.column-min` stacks its cells in source order, so nothing scrolls sideways at 320 px. The only way to put blocks side by side on a page: blocks never nest a page inside themselves. Not for things compared side by side inside a block (use Grid), an app's regions (use AppLayout or EditorLayout) or free positioning (there is none).
a11y: Plain `div`s with no role: the grid arranges, it doesn't group. Reading order is the source order, row by row and cell by cell, at every width. Pointer selection (`onSelect`) is an editor's shortcut; its keyboard path is the editor's outline of the same rows and cells (a TreeView), which sets `selected`.

props.name: rows
props.description: The page's rows, top to bottom. Each row splits into cells; a cell holds rows or is a slot.

props.name: renderSlot
props.description: Fills a slot (a cell without rows) with one block or one fundamental; return nothing to leave it empty.

props.name: selected
props.description: The id of the row or cell an editor has selected: it carries the selection outline (`data-selected`).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Makes rows and cells selectable by pointer, for an editor: a click picks the innermost cell under it, or its row where no cell is (between cells). Keyboard selection belongs to the editor's outline (a TreeView of the same ids).

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id: the key, and `data-cell` on the cell for an editor to find it.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows inside the cell, each dividing the cell's span again. Without rows the cell is a slot: `renderSlot` fills it.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id: the key, and `data-row` on the row.

props.name: split
props.description: How the row divides its span (default `whole`).

props.name: gap
props.description: The space above the row; the first row of a group has none (default `section`).

props.name: cells
props.description: One cell per part of the split, in reading order.
